entities.name: Query protein MurE
observations: 487 aa bacterial protein; predicted molecular weight 53.6 kDa and theoretical pI 8.28.
Has Pfam Mur_ligase (PF01225), Mur_ligase_M (PF08245), and Mur_ligase_C (PF02875) domains spanning the sequence.
Shares 57.8–58.1% identity with reviewed MurE homologs over 98.8–99.4% of the sequence.
Likely catalyzes ATP-dependent ligation of meso-diaminopimelate to UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu.
Likely cytoplasmic and Mg2+-dependent based on highly similar reviewed homologs.

entities.name: MurE ligase
observations: MurE (UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate--2,6-diaminopimelate ligase) is an ATP-dependent enzyme in bacterial peptidoglycan biosynthesis.
EC 6.3.2.13; requires Mg2+ and produces UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu-meso-DAP, ADP, phosphate, and H+.
Reviewed homologs are annotated to cytoplasm, ATP binding, magnesium ion binding, peptidoglycan biosynthesis, cell division, and regulation of cell shape.

entities.name: Peptidoglycan biosynthesis
observations: MurE performs the meso-diaminopimelate ligation step in cytoplasmic peptidoglycan precursor synthesis.
The pathway supports bacterial cell-wall biogenesis, cell division, and maintenance of cell shape.

entities.name: MurE meso-DAP ligation
observations: Mapped to Rhea RHEA:23676 and EC 6.3.2.13 in reviewed homologs.
